column1: # Conservation of the ADCK5 nucleotide-site and KxGQ positions across metazoan orthologs.
# Source: UniProt REST, query (gene:ADCK5) AND (taxonomy_id:33208) AND (length:[400 TO 900]),
# plus the same query on protein_name "aarF domain containing kinase 5"; one entry per species,
# longest isoform kept. Each ortholog aligned to human Q3MIX3 by Needleman-Wunsch,
# BLOSUM62, gap open -11, gap extend -1. No external alignment package was used.
# Entries retained: 245 (pairwise identity to human 39.3-100.0%).
# Entries excluded on fixed criteria (<35% identity or <300 aligned columns):
#   Gallus gallus A0A8V0XW18  33.3% / 432 cols
#   Oncorhynchus tshawytscha A0AAZ3S424  22.5% / 551 cols
# Site-vs-background test, restricted to the PKL kinase core (human residues 190-440):
#   nucleotide-site positions (n=20):  mean identity 0.915, median 0.986, min 0.371
#   all other core positions (n=231):  mean identity 0.761, median 0.894
#   Mann-Whitney U = 3494, one-sided p = 7.25e-05, rank-biserial r = 0.512
# Limitation: the 245 orthologs are not phylogenetically independent, so the p-value describes
# the positional contrast within this sample, not a phylogenetically corrected substitution rate.
# The effect size (0.915 vs 0.761) is the more interpretable statistic.
# Regional mean identity for context:
#   residues 1-120 (N-terminal extension)  0.524
#   residues 131-186 (KxGQ domain)         0.800
#   residues 190-440 (PKL kinase core)     0.773
